witness.note: 074000 identifies the surviving 1522 Jiajing printing; its 1494 preface does not prove an unchanged complete novel in 1494. The later received 120-chapter Mao recension remains distinct.

period.label: 263–280 CE · conquest of Shu to reunification under Jin
period.note: The historical endpoints are the 263 conquest of Shu and 280 fall of Wu. Dates do not certify the intervening fictional speeches or stratagems.

creators.name: Luo Guanzhong
creators.note: Work attribution; distinguish the received text and its transmission from a securely identified single historical author.

description: Concludes the novel with the collapse of Shu, the rival northern commanders, the Sima family's accession to Jin and Wu's surrender in 280, contrasting dynastic legitimacy, institutional capacity and the impermanence of the founders' personal vows.
